clusters.dom:
Category 

Data collected and how we use it 

Account information 

The Anya app supports 3 core Women’s Health areas: Parenting, Menopause and Fertility. Depending on the user’s subscription type, they will have access to specific areas, and may share different information within the app, relevant to the area they are using.  

General across all 3 areas: first name, last name, or similar identifier, your email address, ethnicity, country, postcode (only parenting) and your age. 

Parenting area specific: breastfeeding experience and duration, your child’s due date / date of birth. 

Menopause area specific: menopausal stage. 

Fertility area specific: stage in fertility journey, if you’ve had fertility treatment or not. 

We collect this information in order to: create, administer and maintain your account on our App; to provide our Services to you; to manage our relationship with you, for example to notify you about changes to our Terms of Use, this Privacy Policy or to ask you to leave a review or take a survey. If you choose to, you can also submit your picture (and possibly other information). 

Symptom Data 

Within our app, you’re able to log your symptoms and severity, and can review trends over time. As a user, you chose which data you input and track as part of the Anya App. 

 

Data you’re able to track includes: 

  • General across all app areas: vitamin D, mood. 
  • Parenting specific: folic acid, baby sleep, baby nappies, baby feeds. 
  • Fertility specific: ovulation tests, cervical mucus, and other relevant symptoms. 
  • Menopause specific: core menopause symptoms such as hot flushes, brain fog, night sweats, and other relevant symptoms. 

Website usage 

Website users are passive users and do not create accounts, however, may still be subject to certain passive data collection (“Passive Data Collection”). Such Passive Data Collection may include with cookies, IP address information, location information, and certain browser data, such as history and/or session information. 

Usage Data 

Includes your interests, preferences, opinions, feedback and survey responses, and other information and/or materials uploaded to the App by you, for example your correspondence, enquiries, views, and opinions uploaded via interactive chat features. We will store this information within our App so that you can have access to it for as long as you are our registered user. We may also use it for statistical, research, reporting, and marketing purposes (including by using our Artificial Intelligence technology to improve and further develop our Services), but only in an aggregated and anonymised format (i.e., in a format that does not allow us to identify who this information relates to). 

Technical Information 

Includes information about your device, hardware, or software you use to access the Internet, our App such as IP address or other transactional or identifier information for your device (such as device make and model, information about device operating systems and browsers, or other device or system related specifications). It also includes information about how you use and interact with our App. We collect it using cookies and other tracking technologies and use it to monitor the functioning of our App, to support and further develop the App. 

Special Categories of Personal Data 

This includes information about race or ethnicity, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life, sexual orientation, political opinions, trade union membership, and genetic and biometric data. 

 

We only actively ask for ethnicity as a mandatory field as part of our onboarding process. We use this information to help us understand the demographics of our user base, which informs how we develop and improve our services. 

 

We do not actively ask for any of the other information, but you may submit it during your use of our App, in particular our in-App chat functionality, which allows you to communicate with other users and specialists. Should you provide them, we will only use this data to facilitate your chat interactions, to store them for you in your chat history and we may also us it for statistical and research purposes (see ‘Data Retention’ section for more details).

Lawful Basis (personal data)   

Lawful Basis (special category data)   

Provision of LatchAid programs, some of which is supported by our use of AI.   

6.1 (a) - the data subject has given explicit consent to the processing of his or her personal data, or the personal data of an individual for whom they have parental responsibility   

9.2 (a) - the data subject has given explicit consent to the processing of his or her personal data, or the personal data of an individual for whom they have parental responsibility   

Improving Anya services, to improve effectiveness of our services and maximise patient safety   

6.1 (f) – processing is undertaken in the legitimate interest in patient healthcare   

9.2 (g) – processing is undertaken for reasons of substantial public interest, specifically to provide counselling, support, and safeguarding of children and at risk individuals   

Customer reporting

Patient protection and safeguards  

6.1 (f) – processing is undertaken in the legitimate interest in patient healthcare

Managing customer interactions (including complaints, enquiries, feedback, etc)

Category 

Data collected and how we use it 

Account information 

The Anya app supports 3 core Women’s Health areas: Parenting, Menopause and Fertility. Depending on the user’s subscription type, they will have access to specific areas, and may share different information within the app, relevant to the area they are using.  

General across all 3 areas: first name, last name, or similar identifier, your email address, ethnicity, country, postcode (only parenting) and your age. 

Parenting area specific: breastfeeding experience and duration, your child’s due date / date of birth. 

Menopause area specific: menopausal stage. 

Fertility area specific: stage in fertility journey, if you’ve had fertility treatment or not. 

We collect this information in order to: create, administer and maintain your account on our App; to provide our Services to you; to manage our relationship with you, for example to notify you about changes to our Terms of Use, this Privacy Policy or to ask you to leave a review or take a survey. If you choose to, you can also submit your picture (and possibly other information). 

Symptom Data 

Within our app, you’re able to log your symptoms and severity, and can review trends over time. As a user, you chose which data you input and track as part of the Anya App. 

 

Data you’re able to track includes: 

  • General across all app areas: vitamin D, mood. 
  • Parenting specific: folic acid, baby sleep, baby nappies, baby feeds. 
  • Fertility specific: ovulation tests, cervical mucus, and other relevant symptoms. 
  • Menopause specific: core menopause symptoms such as hot flushes, brain fog, night sweats, and other relevant symptoms. 

Website usage 

Website users are passive users and do not create accounts, however, may still be subject to certain passive data collection (“Passive Data Collection”). Such Passive Data Collection may include with cookies, IP address information, location information, and certain browser data, such as history and/or session information. 

Usage Data 

Includes your interests, preferences, opinions, feedback and survey responses, and other information and/or materials uploaded to the App by you, for example your correspondence, enquiries, views, and opinions uploaded via interactive chat features. We will store this information within our App so that you can have access to it for as long as you are our registered user. We may also use it for statistical, research, reporting, and marketing purposes (including by using our Artificial Intelligence technology to improve and further develop our Services), but only in an aggregated and anonymised format (i.e., in a format that does not allow us to identify who this information relates to). 

Technical Information 

Includes information about your device, hardware, or software you use to access the Internet, our App such as IP address or other transactional or identifier information for your device (such as device make and model, information about device operating systems and browsers, or other device or system related specifications). It also includes information about how you use and interact with our App. We collect it using cookies and other tracking technologies and use it to monitor the functioning of our App, to support and further develop the App. 

Special Categories of Personal Data 

This includes information about race or ethnicity, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life, sexual orientation, political opinions, trade union membership, and genetic and biometric data. 

 

We only actively ask for ethnicity as a mandatory field as part of our onboarding process. We use this information to help us understand the demographics of our user base, which informs how we develop and improve our services. 

 

We do not actively ask for any of the other information, but you may submit it during your use of our App, in particular our in-App chat functionality, which allows you to communicate with other users and specialists. Should you provide them, we will only use this data to facilitate your chat interactions, to store them for you in your chat history and we may also us it for statistical and research purposes (see ‘Data Retention’ section for more details).

Lawful Basis (special category data)   

Provision of LatchAid programs, some of which is supported by our use of AI.

9.2 (a) - the data subject has given explicit consent to the processing of his or her personal data, or the personal data of an individual for whom they have parental responsibility   

Improving Anya services, to improve effectiveness of our services and maximise patient safety

Customer reporting
